AuthDiagnosis.description:
><notice>The diagnosis feature requires a service-linked role to be created under a Resource Access Management (RAM) user. When you call this API, it automatically checks whether the service-linked role exists. If the role does not exist, the API automatically creates it. This requires the RAM user invoking this API to have the ram:CreateServiceLinkedRole permission.</notice>

When calling this API to authorize SysOM to diagnose ECS instances, note the following:
- Each authorization is valid for 7 days. After 7 days, the authorization expires, and you must call this API again to re-authorize.
- If the SysOM service-linked role (AliyunServiceRoleForSysom) does not exist when you call this API, it will be automatically created. This requires the RAM user invoking this API to have the `ram:CreateServiceLinkedRole` permission.
- When you authorize a specific instance through this API, the system automatically adds the label `sysom:diagnosis` to the target ECS instance. SysOM can only diagnose instances that have this label.

## Parameter Guide for Diagnosis

### Memory Dashboard Diagnosis (memgraph) Parameters  
The memgraph (memory全景 analysis) tool is suitable for scenarios where memory usage is high but the specific source of memory consumption cannot be clearly identified. By using the memory全景 analysis diagnostic feature, you can scan the current system's memory usage status and obtain a detailed breakdown of memory utilization, including the distribution between system memory and application memory. It also provides a sorted list of the top 30 applications by memory usage, file cache usage, and shared memory cache usage.

| Parameter Name | Parameter Type | Parameter Guide | Required | Default Value | Remarks                                                    |
|----------------|----------------|------------------|----------|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| uid            | string         | User UID         | Yes      |               | User UID                                                  |
| region         | string         | Instance Region  | Yes      |               | Region where the instance resides                         |
| instance       | string         | Instance ID      | Yes      |               | Enter the instance ID you want to diagnose. We will initiate diagnostics on this machine. |
| pod            | string         | Pod Name         | No       |               | Pod Name                                                  |

### Java Memory Diagnosis (javamem) Parameters  
The javamem (Java memory diagnosis) tool is primarily used to diagnose Java application memory usage. It helps users understand the distribution and composition of Java heap memory and non-heap memory, detect potential memory leaks and out-of-memory (OOM) issues, and achieve measurable, traceable, and maintainable Java memory management.

| Parameter Name | Parameter Type | Parameter Guide                     | Required | Default Value | Remarks                                                       |
|----------------|----------------|-------------------------------------|----------|---------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| uid            | string         | User UID                            | Yes      |               | User UID                                                     |
| region         | string         | Instance Region                     | Yes      |               | Region where the instance resides                            |
| instance       | string         | Instance ID                         | Yes      |               | Enter the instance ID you want to diagnose. We will initiate diagnostics on this machine. |
| pid            | string         | Java Process PID                    | No       |               | Java process PID; either pid or pod must be provided.        |
| pod            | string         | Pod Name                            | No       |               | Pod Name; either pid or pod must be provided.                |
| duration       | string         | JNI Memory Allocation Profiling Duration | No    |               | JNI memory allocation profiling duration. To execute JNI diagnosis, specify a non-zero value; otherwise, JNI diagnosis is skipped by default. |

### Memory OOM Diagnosis (oomcheck) Parameters  
The oomcheck (OOM diagnosis) tool is primarily used to analyze and identify the root cause of out-of-memory (OOM) issues, provide corresponding remediation suggestions, and help users resolve OOM problems to improve system availability and performance.

| Parameter Name | Parameter Type | Parameter Guide | Required | Default Value | Remarks                                                    |
|----------------|----------------|------------------|----------|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| uid            | string         | User UID         | Yes      |               | User UID                                                  |
| region         | string         | Instance Region  | Yes      |               | Region where the instance resides                         |
| instance       | string         | Instance ID      | Yes      |               | Enter the instance ID you want to diagnose. We will initiate diagnostics on this machine. |
| pod            | string         | Pod Name         | No       |               | Pod Name                                                  |
| time           | string         | Diagnosis Time   | No       |               | Enter the timestamp for OOM diagnosis. Defaults to the most recent occurrence. |

### System Load Diagnosis (loadtask) Parameters  
The loadtask (system load diagnosis) tool primarily analyzes the root cause of abnormal one-minute average system load (load1 metric) and provides detailed information about the affected machine.

| Parameter Name | Parameter Type | Parameter Guide | Required | Default Value | Remarks                                                    |
|----------------|----------------|------------------|----------|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| uid            | string         | User UID         | Yes      |               | User UID                                                  |
| region         | string         | Instance Region  | Yes      |               | Region where the instance resides                         |
| instance       | string         | Instance ID      | Yes      |               | Enter the instance ID you want to diagnose. We will initiate diagnostics on this machine. |

### Scheduling Jitter Diagnosis (delay) Parameters  
The delay (scheduling jitter diagnosis) tool primarily analyzes issues caused by prolonged CPU task switching delays, which prevent user-space business processes from being scheduled for extended periods (e.g., in memory reclamation scenarios).

| Parameter Name | Parameter Type | Parameter Guide        | Required | Default Value | Remarks                                                    |
|----------------|----------------|------------------------|----------|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| uid            | string         | User UID               | Yes      |               | User UID                                                  |
| region         | string         | Instance Region        | Yes      |               | Region where the instance resides                         |
| instance       | string         | Instance ID            | Yes      |               | Enter the instance ID you want to diagnose. We will initiate diagnostics on this machine. |
| duration       | string         | Diagnosis Duration     | No       | 20            | Diagnosis duration (in seconds, optional). Default is 20 seconds. |
| threshold      | string         | Diagnosis Threshold    | No       | 20            | Latency threshold (in ms). Events exceeding this threshold are recorded. Default is 20 ms. |

### IO Traffic Analysis Diagnosis (iofsstat) Parameters  
The iofsstat (IO traffic analysis) tool primarily identifies the sources of IO traffic in the system. The results include IO traffic statistics per disk/partition and per process.

| Parameter Name | Parameter Type | Parameter Guide          | Required | Default Value | Remarks                                                         |
|----------------|----------------|--------------------------|----------|---------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
| uid            | string         | User UID                 | Yes      |               | User UID                                                      |
| region         | string         | Instance Region          | Yes      |               | Region where the instance resides                             |
| instance       | string         | Instance ID              | Yes      |               | Enter the instance ID you want to diagnose. We will initiate IO traffic statistics collection on this machine. |
| timeout        | string         | Diagnosis Duration       | No       | 15            | Diagnosis duration (also the IO traffic statistic period), in seconds. Recommended not to exceed 60 seconds. |
| disk           | string         | Target Disk              | No       | ""            | Enter the disk to diagnose (e.g., vda, sda). Defaults to all disks. |

### One-Click IO Diagnosis (iodiagnose) Parameters  
The iodiagnose (one-click IO diagnosis) tool focuses on frequently occurring IO issues such as high IO latency, IO bursts, and high IO wait. It supports identification of various IO problem types, invokes appropriate sub-tools to analyze IO data, and provides conclusions and recommendations.

| Parameter Name | Parameter Type | Parameter Guide          | Required | Default Value | Remarks                                                         |
|----------------|----------------|--------------------------|----------|---------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
| uid            | string         | User UID                 | Yes      |               | User UID                                                      |
| region         | string         | Instance Region          | Yes      |               | Region where the instance resides                             |
| instance       | string         | Instance ID              | Yes      |               | Enter the instance ID you want to diagnose. We will initiate IO hang diagnostics on this machine. |
| timeout        | string         | Diagnosis Duration       | No       | 30            | Diagnosis duration (optional), in seconds. Default is 30 seconds. Not recommended to set below 30 seconds. |

### Network Packet Loss Diagnosis (packetdrop) Parameters  
The packetdrop (network packet loss diagnosis) tool primarily analyzes packet loss occurring at the operating system kernel level during network transmission due to various causes.

| Parameter Name | Parameter Type | Parameter Guide | Required | Default Value | Remarks                                                    |
|----------------|----------------|------------------|----------|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| uid            | string         | User UID         | Yes      |               | User UID                                                  |
| region         | string         | Instance Region  | Yes      |               | Region where the instance resides                         |
| instance       | string         | Instance ID      | Yes      |               | Enter the instance ID you want to diagnose. We will initiate diagnostics on this machine. |

### Network Jitter Diagnosis (netjitter) Parameters  
The netjitter (network jitter diagnosis) tool primarily analyzes kernel-level instability in the operating system caused by various factors during network packet transmission.

| Parameter Name | Parameter Type | Parameter Guide                | Required | Default Value | Remarks                                                    |
|----------------|----------------|--------------------------------|----------|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| uid            | string         | User UID                       | Yes      |               | User UID                                                  |
| region         | string         | Instance Region                | Yes      |               | Region where the instance resides                         |
| instance       | string         | Instance ID                    | Yes      |               | Enter the instance ID you want to diagnose. We will initiate diagnostics on this machine. |
| duration       | string         | Diagnosis Duration             | No       | 20            | Diagnosis duration (in seconds, optional). Default is 20 seconds. |
| threshold      | string         | Jitter Detection Threshold     | No       | 10            | Jitter detection threshold (in ms, optional). Default is 10 ms. |

### Breakdown Diagnosis (vmcore) Parameters  
The vmcore (breakdown diagnosis) tool primarily analyzes the cause of operating system crashes by examining kernel panic-generated core dump files in conjunction with dmesg logs.

| Parameter Name | Parameter Type | Parameter Guide | Required | Default Value | Remarks                                                    |
|----------------|----------------|------------------|----------|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| uid            | string         | User UID         | Yes      |               | User UID                                                  |
| region         | string         | Instance Region  | Yes      |               | Region where the instance resides                         |
| instance       | string         | Instance ID      | Yes      |               | Enter the instance ID you want to diagnose. We will initiate diagnostics on this machine. |

### Disk Analysis Diagnosis (diskanalysis) Parameters  
The diskanalysis (disk analysis diagnosis) tool primarily analyzes disk usage within the system.

| Parameter Name | Parameter Type | Parameter Guide | Required | Default Value | Remarks                                                    |
|----------------|----------------|------------------|----------|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| uid            | string         | User UID         | Yes      |               | User UID                                                  |
